arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo TELEGRAM_LEADS_CACHE_CLEAN_START
sudo -n /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
state=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/operation-state.json')
marker=root/'.verified-source-commit'
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
sessions=sorted(vault.glob('*.session'))
assert len(sessions)==2
def digest():
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 for path in (state,marker,*sessions):
  assert path.is_file()
  h.update(path.read_bytes())
 return h.digest()
before=digest()
cmd=[sys.executable,'-B',str(root/'scripts/project_hygiene.py'),'--root',str(root),'--apply','--confirm-telegram-only']
result=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
print('CLEAN_EXIT',result.returncode)
assert result.returncode==0
obj=json.loads(result.stdout)
print('CLEAN_STATUS',obj.get('status'))
print('REMOVED_CACHE_FILES',obj.get('removed_files'))
assert obj['status']=='APPLIED'
assert digest()==before
print('PRIVATE_STATE_SESSIONS_AND_VERSION_UNCHANGED')
print('TELEGRAM_LEADS_CACHE_CLEAN_PASS')
PY
